changelog:
Continue Watching resumes episodes, same-named sources both come back from a restore, and an interrupted add keeps what it saved.

WHAT CHANGED

- Continue Watching now resumes an episode of a series where you stopped, shows only what the Series and Movies tabs show, and updates when the catalog reloads, so a title that is gone leaves the rail and a changed address is the one that plays. The rail also shows above a category that is empty or failed to load, and holding one of its tiles opens the same menu as in the grid.
- Catch-up addresses built from a provider's template keep the provider's own server, and catch-up that rewrites the live address keeps the access token in it, so catch-up on those providers plays instead of failing.
- Two sources with the same name now both come back from a restore, each with its own categories; before this version only the first was restored, and it could take the second one's category choices.
- If the app is restarted while a source is being added and the retry then fails, the channels, films and series it had already saved stay instead of being removed.
- When the phone's storage is full or the database fails during a refresh, the background guide refresh now pauses for an hour as it was meant to, and resumes as soon as a refresh you start succeeds.
- A source you add while a refresh fails with a database problem is still imported; before, it was left with no channels until you refreshed.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.11: casting to the television, up to eight phones per television, recording, pause and rewind on live TV, and the safer backups.
